About Cyanos Lab

Cyanos Lab pursues research and software development with a mission to contribute to technology—especially AI—and the life sciences.

Cyanos Lab is a research and development initiative operated by Shoko Oka as a sole proprietorship.

Focus Areas

  • AI-assisted life science research
  • MCP-based research infrastructure and software development
  • Research on the cognitive capacities of large language models
  • AI agent governance and accountability

Members

S

Shoko Oka / shooka

Software Engineer / Independent Researcher

Shoko founded Cyanos Lab while working at a major Japanese IT company. She develops and maintains Promethica, an open-source life science exploration tool, and researches AI cognition as well as AI agent governance. She is the author of The Complete Guide to MCP Server Development, published by Gijutsu-Hyoron Co., Ltd.
